# Case 23: Sufficiency assumption in place of a requested model
Skill: write-system-models (revised model), write-revision-responses (response)
Expected gates: G-SM-scope, G-RV-model
Language: en
Snippet:
> Reviewer comment: Model the energy that the supporting vessel spends on station keeping and relocation.
>
> Revised model: The vessel is powered by a large onboard generator, and its energy supply is assumed to be sufficient throughout the mission. Its energy is therefore outside the scope of this study.
Why it fails: the reviewer asked for a model. A sufficiency assumption replaces it without evidence, so the comment remains unanswered.
